## 基本記号

インライン数式:
$e^{i\pi}+1=0$,
$\sum_{k=0}^{n}\binom{n}{k}x^ky^{n-k}=(x+y)^n$,
$\nabla\cdot(\nabla\times\mathbf{A})=0$,
$\Gamma(z)=\int_0^\infty t^{z-1}e^{-t}\,dt$,
$\zeta(s)=\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}n^{-s}$,
$\operatorname{Li}_s(z)=\sum_{k=1}^{\infty}\frac{z^k}{k^s}$.

---

### 1. 多重和・積・極限

$$
S_{1}(n)
=
\sum_{a_1=0}^n
\sum_{a_2=0}^{a_1}
\sum_{a_3=0}^{a_2}
\sum_{a_4=0}^{a_3}
\frac{(-1)^{a_1+a_2+a_3+a_4}
\binom{n}{a_1}
\binom{a_1}{a_2}
\binom{a_2}{a_3}
\binom{a_3}{a_4}}
{(1+a_1)^2(1+a_2)^3(1+a_3)^4(1+a_4)^5}
$$

$$
P_{1}(x)
=
\prod_{k=1}^{25}
\left(
1+\frac{x}{k}
+\frac{x^2}{2!k^2}
+\frac{x^3}{3!k^3}
+\frac{x^4}{4!k^4}
\right)
$$

$$
L_{1}
=
\lim_{n\to\infty}
n^{3}
\left[
\sum_{k=1}^n
\frac{1}{k^{3}}
-
\zeta(3)
+
\sum_{r=1}^{5}
\frac{B_{2r}}{(2r)!}
\frac{(3)_{2r-1}}{n^{3+2r-1}}
\right]
$$

インライン負荷: $x_{1}^{3}+\frac{\alpha_{1,1}}{1+\beta_{1}^2}+\sqrt[3]{1+\gamma_{1}x^2}$ $x_{2}^{4}+\frac{\alpha_{1,2}}{1+\beta_{2}^2}+\sqrt[4]{1+\gamma_{2}x^2}$ $x_{3}^{5}+\frac{\alpha_{1,3}}{1+\beta_{3}^2}+\sqrt[5]{1+\gamma_{3}x^2}$ $x_{4}^{6}+\frac{\alpha_{1,4}}{1+\beta_{4}^2}+\sqrt[6]{1+\gamma_{4}x^2}$ $x_{5}^{7}+\frac{\alpha_{1,5}}{1+\beta_{5}^2}+\sqrt[2]{1+\gamma_{5}x^2}$ $x_{6}^{8}+\frac{\alpha_{1,6}}{1+\beta_{6}^2}+\sqrt[3]{1+\gamma_{6}x^2}$ $x_{7}^{9}+\frac{\alpha_{1,7}}{1+\beta_{7}^2}+\sqrt[4]{1+\gamma_{7}x^2}$ $x_{8}^{1}+\frac{\alpha_{1,8}}{1+\beta_{8}^2}+\sqrt[5]{1+\gamma_{8}x^2}$ $x_{9}^{2}+\frac{\alpha_{1,9}}{1+\beta_{9}^2}+\sqrt[6]{1+\gamma_{9}x^2}$ $x_{10}^{3}+\frac{\alpha_{1,10}}{1+\beta_{10}^2}+\sqrt[2]{1+\gamma_{10}x^2}$ $x_{11}^{4}+\frac{\alpha_{1,11}}{1+\beta_{11}^2}+\sqrt[3]{1+\gamma_{11}x^2}$ $x_{12}^{5}+\frac{\alpha_{1,12}}{1+\beta_{12}^2}+\sqrt[4]{1+\gamma_{12}x^2}$

### 2. 積分・特殊関数

$$
I_{2}(\alpha,\beta,\gamma)
=
\int_0^\infty
\int_0^\pi
\int_0^{2\pi}
r^{5-1}
e^{-\alpha r^2}
\sin^{4}\theta
\exp\!\left(
\beta r\cos\theta
+
\gamma r^2\sin^2\theta\cos(2\phi)
\right)
\,d\phi\,d\theta\,dr
$$

$$
F_{2}(z)
=
\frac{1}{2\pi i}
\oint_{|w|=1.2}
\frac{
\Gamma(w+3)
\Gamma(4-w)
\zeta(2w+2)
\operatorname{Li}_{w+3}(z)
}
{\Gamma(5+w)\sin(\pi w)}
\,dw
$$

$$
\mathcal{M}_{2}(s)
=
\int_0^\infty
x^{s-1}
\left[
J_{2}(x)^2
+
Y_{2}(x)^2
+
K_{2}(x)^2
\right]
e^{-x/3}\,dx
$$

インライン負荷: $x_{1}^{4}+\frac{\alpha_{2,1}}{1+\beta_{1}^2}+\sqrt[3]{1+\gamma_{1}x^2}$ $x_{2}^{5}+\frac{\alpha_{2,2}}{1+\beta_{2}^2}+\sqrt[4]{1+\gamma_{2}x^2}$ $x_{3}^{6}+\frac{\alpha_{2,3}}{1+\beta_{3}^2}+\sqrt[5]{1+\gamma_{3}x^2}$ $x_{4}^{7}+\frac{\alpha_{2,4}}{1+\beta_{4}^2}+\sqrt[6]{1+\gamma_{4}x^2}$ $x_{5}^{8}+\frac{\alpha_{2,5}}{1+\beta_{5}^2}+\sqrt[2]{1+\gamma_{5}x^2}$ $x_{6}^{9}+\frac{\alpha_{2,6}}{1+\beta_{6}^2}+\sqrt[3]{1+\gamma_{6}x^2}$ $x_{7}^{1}+\frac{\alpha_{2,7}}{1+\beta_{7}^2}+\sqrt[4]{1+\gamma_{7}x^2}$ $x_{8}^{2}+\frac{\alpha_{2,8}}{1+\beta_{8}^2}+\sqrt[5]{1+\gamma_{8}x^2}$ $x_{9}^{3}+\frac{\alpha_{2,9}}{1+\beta_{9}^2}+\sqrt[6]{1+\gamma_{9}x^2}$ $x_{10}^{4}+\frac{\alpha_{2,10}}{1+\beta_{10}^2}+\sqrt[2]{1+\gamma_{10}x^2}$ $x_{11}^{5}+\frac{\alpha_{2,11}}{1+\beta_{11}^2}+\sqrt[3]{1+\gamma_{11}x^2}$ $x_{12}^{6}+\frac{\alpha_{2,12}}{1+\beta_{12}^2}+\sqrt[4]{1+\gamma_{12}x^2}$

$$

$$

$$
\mathcal{F}[u]
=
\int_\Omega
\left[
\frac{\kappa}{2}|\nabla u|^2
+
\frac{\mu}{4}(u^2-1)^2
+
\frac{\rho}{2}
\left|
\nabla^2u
\right|_F^2
+
\sum_{|\alpha|\le 6}
c_\alpha
D^\alpha u
\right]dx
$$

$$
R^{\rho}_{\ \sigma\mu\nu}
=
\partial_\mu\Gamma^\rho_{\nu\sigma}
-
\partial_\nu\Gamma^\rho_{\mu\sigma}
+
\Gamma^\rho_{\mu\lambda}
\Gamma^\lambda_{\nu\sigma}
-
\Gamma^\rho_{\nu\lambda}
\Gamma^\lambda_{\mu\sigma}
$$

$$

=

p_{6}(x)
\log
\frac{p_{6}(x)}{q_{6}(x)}
\,dx
,\qquad
I(X;Y)
=
\sum_{x,y}
p(x,y)
\log
\frac{p(x,y)}{p(x)p(y)}
$$

$$

\lambda\sum_{k=1}^n X_k

インライン負荷: $x_{1}^{1}+\frac{\alpha_{2600,1}}{1+\beta_{1}^2}+\sqrt[3]{1+\gamma_{1}x^2}$ $x_{2}^{2}+\frac{\alpha_{2600,2}}{1+\beta_{2}^2}+\sqrt[4]{1+\gamma_{2}x^2}$ $x_{3}^{3}+\frac{\alpha_{2600,3}}{1+\beta_{3}^2}+\sqrt[5]{1+\gamma_{3}x^2}$ $x_{4}^{4}+\frac{\alpha_{2600,4}}{1+\beta_{4}^2}+\sqrt[6]{1+\gamma_{4}x^2}$ $x_{5}^{5}+\frac{\alpha_{2600,5}}{1+\beta_{5}^2}+\sqrt[2]{1+\gamma_{5}x^2}$ $x_{6}^{6}+\frac{\alpha_{2600,6}}{1+\beta_{6}^2}+\sqrt[3]{1+\gamma_{6}x^2}$ $x_{7}^{7}+\frac{\alpha_{2600,7}}{1+\beta_{7}^2}+\sqrt[4]{1+\gamma_{7}x^2}$ $x_{8}^{8}+\frac{\alpha_{2600,8}}{1+\beta_{8}^2}+\sqrt[5]{1+\gamma_{8}x^2}$ $x_{9}^{9}+\frac{\alpha_{2600,9}}{1+\beta_{9}^2}+\sqrt[6]{1+\gamma_{9}x^2}$ $x_{10}^{1}+\frac{\alpha_{2600,10}}{1+\beta_{10}^2}+\sqrt[2]{1+\gamma_{10}x^2}$ $x_{11}^{2}+\frac{\alpha_{2600,11}}{1+\beta_{11}^2}+\sqrt[3]{1+\gamma_{11}x^2}$ $x_{12}^{3}+\frac{\alpha_{2600,12}}{1+\beta_{12}^2}+\sqrt[4]{1+\gamma_{12}x^2}$

# 最終巨大式

$$
\boxed{
\mathcal{Z}
=
\lim_{N\to\infty}
\int_{\mathbb{R}^{N}}

-\frac12 x^\top A x
-\sum_{k=3}^{12}\frac{\lambda_k}{k!}

T^{(k)}_{i_1\cdots i_k}
x_{i_1}\cdots x_{i_k}
\right)
\prod_{j=1}^{N}
\left[
1+
\sum_{m=1}^{16}
\frac{H_m(x_j)}{m!}
\right]
\,d^Nx
}
$$
